# HowToStopJunkMail.org

> Free guides and tools to help people stop unwanted physical junk mail in the United States.

## About

HowToStopJunkMail.org provides step-by-step guides, opt-out tools, and resources for reducing or eliminating unsolicited direct mail. All core tools are free. The site covers USPS mail, credit card offers, political mailers, mail for deceased persons, and more.

## Tools

- [Opt-Out Kit](https://howtostopjunkmail.org/tools/opt-out-kit/) — Personalized checklist of opt-out steps based on the types of mail you receive
- [Identify My Mail](https://howtostopjunkmail.org/tools/identify-mail/) — Helps users identify what kind of junk mail they have and how to stop it
- [Letter Generator](https://howtostopjunkmail.org/tools/letter-generator/) — Generates printable opt-out letters to send to mailers
- [Savings Calculator](https://howtostopjunkmail.org/tools/savings-calculator/) — Estimates time and money saved by stopping junk mail
- [Send a Letter](https://howtostopjunkmail.org/tools/send-letter/) — Paid service to send opt-out letters on the user's behalf
- [Mailer Directory](https://howtostopjunkmail.org/tools/mailer-directory/) — Directory of major direct mailers with opt-out contact info

## Guides

- [How to Stop Junk Mail](https://howtostopjunkmail.org/guides/how-to-stop-junk-mail/) — The complete playbook. Free methods, paid options, and services ranked by effectiveness.
- [Return Junk Mail to Sender](https://howtostopjunkmail.org/guides/return-junk-mail-to-sender/) — How Business Reply Mail works and how to make junk mailers pay their own postage back.
- [Junk Mail Revenge](https://howtostopjunkmail.org/guides/junk-mail-revenge/) — Legal tactics for making senders regret mailing you.
- [Stop Credit Card Mail](https://howtostopjunkmail.org/guides/stop-credit-card-mail/) — OptOutPrescreen and beyond. Stop pre-screened offers for good.
- [Opt-Out Services Compared](https://howtostopjunkmail.org/guides/opt-out-services-compared/) — DMAchoice vs Incogni vs DeleteMe vs CatalogChoice, ranked honestly.
- [Stop Mail for a Deceased Person](https://howtostopjunkmail.org/guides/stop-junk-mail-deceased-person/) — How to stop mail arriving for someone who has passed away.
- [Stop Mail from Previous Owner](https://howtostopjunkmail.org/guides/how-to-stop-unwanted-mail-from-previous-owner/) — Keep getting mail for the previous resident? Here is what to do legally.
- [Stop Military Junk Mail](https://howtostopjunkmail.org/guides/stop-military-junk-mail/) — Opt-out options specific to military personnel and veterans.
- [Stop Political Junk Mail](https://howtostopjunkmail.org/guides/stop-political-junk-mail/) — Why political mail is different and what you can actually do about it.
- [Junk Mail vs. Spam](https://howtostopjunkmail.org/guides/junk-mail-vs-spam/) — What counts as junk mail, what counts as spam, and why it matters for opting out.
- [Can You Recycle Junk Mail?](https://howtostopjunkmail.org/guides/can-you-recycle-junk-mail/) — What goes in the bin and what does not, by mail type.
- [What Is a BRM Envelope?](https://howtostopjunkmail.org/guides/what-is-a-brm-envelope/) — Business Reply Mail explained, including how senders are charged.
- [Junk Mail Statistics (2026 Guide)](https://howtostopjunkmail.org/guides/junk-mail-statistics/) — Up-to-date junk mail statistics for 2026. Volume, environmental impact, taxpayer costs, and time waste -- all sourced and cited.

## Key Facts

- Americans receive an estimated 100 billion pieces of junk mail per year
- The average household gets 848 pieces of junk mail annually
- Stopping junk mail can save 70+ hours per year
- Opt-out registries include: DMAchoice, OptOutPrescreen.com, Catalog Choice, USPS Mail Preferences, deceased mail registries
- Most opt-outs take effect within 30–90 days
